task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, then pull the current weather alert card for London and archive it under “Daily Travel Weather Archive” for user_882 with medium priority in the app. After that, convert the archive result into text, use that text to create a document and send a low-priority email notification to user_882, and then email the same text to manager@travelagency.com with the subject “Weather Archival Report.”

user_input.query: Please check the current time in New York using the America/New_York timezone, then get the current weather alert card for London and archive it in “Daily Travel Weather Archive” for user_882 with medium priority. After that, convert the archive result into text, use that text to create a document, and send a low-priority email notification to user_882. Finally, email the same text to manager@travelagency.com with the subject “Weather Archival Report.”
